desc: Establish that each prime valuation independently follows prescribed absolute adjacent differences and that the gcd condition normalizes each prime’s minimum exponent to zero.
Implement per-prime DP using the first position attaining the normalized minimum.
Factor all \(A_i\), process each occurring prime independently, and multiply normalized weighted sums modulo \(998244353\).
Encode transition weights, boundary handling, and zero-valuation edges.
Validate the implementation against all provided samples and assess complexity.
